scope: Read-only source and literature research into numerical CFD convergence and inner/outer solve diagnosis. No new native run, build, measurement, physical qualification or agent improvement demonstration.
author_role: delegated numerical-method researcher in the parent engineering task
summary_tr: En yüksek bilgi değerli sonraki iş, aynı assembled FGMRES çağrısında gerçek b-Aδ artığının pasif ölçümüdür. Kaynak256 iç kestirimi iyileştirirken dış yoğunlukta kayıtlı kazancı sağlamadı. Bütün yeni kollarda akış ve SA 200/200 adımda40 tavanda; güncel gerçek lineer artık yok. Ölçüm, aynı A/b ile doğrulandıktan sonra güncelleme/globalizasyon/bağlaşım ayrımı yapılmalı. Rastgele CFL, Krylov veya çizgi uzunluğu taraması gerekçelenmiyor.
priority_basis: Impact on present qualification plus dependency/information value. N01 observability precedes N02 even though N02 carries the larger physical-use consequence.

regions: 194-232 CGS twice despite legacy function name
181-334 flow NK update, tolerance relaxation and startup
914-1005 pseudotime diagonal, signed RHS, zero initial increment and under-relaxed update

latest_results.scope: Three fresh 200-step diagnostic arms; not systematic mesh-family members
cautions: reported inner ratios are reduced-system estimates, not independent b-Ax recomputations
coverage uses the same old sequential-stage RHS, not the current implicit nonlinear residual
Krylov cap saturation makes the old ratio gate non-discriminating in this pair
wall time pair is an observation, not general benchmark
old fine3999 family role and failing acceptance are unchanged

problems.title_tr: Gerçek iç lineer artık ölçümü eksik
problems.status: confirmed observability gap; residual-gap mechanism unproven
problems.evidence: All arms hit40 in every flow/SA solve. CSysSolve returns beta/norm0; recomputation is conditional, off in ordinary primal path.
hypotheses: reduced-system estimate and true residual may differ
both may agree and expose a genuine but insufficient inner reduction
problems.test: Add passive scratch b-Aδ norm at the actual assembled FGMRES call, initially one selected flow and one SA call. Record absolute/relative/component norms, norm0, x0, A/b identity, scalar type and stage.
acceptance_and_stop: analytic nonzero/singular-guard/zero-RHS/already-solved norm tests first
instrumented source32 must reproduce the unchanged numerical path
stop if state or input/operator identity changes or monitoring cannot be shown passive
new observation thresholds require preregistration; no post-result choice
problems.expected_information: Separate misleading inner indicator from insufficient solution of the actual linear problem.
problems.lightweight_fit: Existing native C++ compiler and incremental build; one extra matvec per selected call plus scratch arrays; no external solver installation.

problems.title_tr: İnce kaynak ailede dış yakınsama geçmedi
problems.evidence: Original selected fine3999 SI log density about-9.7154 failed; coarse and medium passed the local iterative gate. Cap256 gained-0.009386log rather than+0.3log.
problems.test: After N01, compare32/256 at the same initial nonlinear stage with A and b hashes identical; record solvedδ, appliedΔU, under-relaxation and CFL. Distinguish pre/post update flow and SA states.
acceptance_and_stop: A/b mismatch prohibits a fixed-system causal comparison
positivity, finite data and coeval fields remain mandatory
measurement acceptance does not close old family qualification
only one subsequent mechanism gets a new bounded preregistered effect contract
problems.expected_information: Locate whether the useful inner correction is lost during the applied update or nonlinear model/coupling stage.
problems.lightweight_fit: First-step diagnostic pair instead of a4000-step campaign; no automatic extension.

problems.title_tr: Eski RHS kapsamı güncel hata konumunu temsil etmiyor
problems.status: confirmed scope limitation; current location not measured
problems.evidence: 0.9997901025323731 is membership overlap with a frozen old sequential-stage density RHS squared norm. It is not a new implicit residual or an error budget.
hypotheses: present dominant residual or weak coupling may be elsewhere
membership expansion may not improve the correction direction even at the same location
problems.test: Use the same N01 stage b and rL to export every owned point and component; verify sums against that native solve. Keep old/current identity and overlapping-region semantics explicit.
acceptance_and_stop: reject a map whose norm does not reconstruct the same-call native measurement
never infer line IDs from graph colors
do not remove unmapped or outside-view nodes
a valid map remains a location indicator rather than mesh-error estimate
problems.expected_information: Test the remaining coverage/coupling argument using current data rather than the historical field.
problems.lightweight_fit: Additional output from the same passive selected calls, no separate CFD campaign.

problems.title_tr: Doygun Krylov sayımı maliyeti ayırt etmiyor
problems.evidence: All totals16000 equal200×(40+40). Longer linelets cost95.109s versus74.125s in one pair; operation costs need not match per iteration.
hypotheses: flow/SA costs differ under one shared cap
preconditioner build and apply dominate independently of Krylov count
problems.test: Separate existing flow/SA counters first, then selected-call matvec/build/apply/update timing and counts if needed. Measure reduction in true residual per recorded resource.
acceptance_and_stop: old gates remain unchanged
future contract includes actual wall time, RAM and operator counts rather than just capped iterations
one time pair cannot support universal speedup
problems.expected_information: Choose a mechanism by useful progress and actual observed cost, without cap-induced false equivalence.
problems.lightweight_fit: Read-only counter analysis and optional local timers; no new dependencies.

problems.title_tr: Tam Cf eğrisindeki fark pencere kabulünden büyük
problems.status: confirmed discrepancy outside preregistered comparison window; cause unproven
problems.evidence: Cf window errors roughly0.20%/0.23%; all447-point errors17.84%/9.62%. Leading-edge samples are retained.
problems.test: Audit full error versus x and source mesh/BC locations, exact flow/SA/viscosity/reference definitions. Only then define a separate leading-edge numerical-representation study if needed.
acceptance_and_stop: retain every original point and evaluation
do not move comparison windows after results
changed physics/geometry requires a new case/family
no new GCI before iterative and asymptotic prerequisites
problems.expected_information: Separate a documented boundary singularity from a correctable implementation/representation mismatch.
problems.lightweight_fit: Initially existing files and primary reference comparison only.

problems.title_tr: İleri yöntemlerin native primal/ayrı-SA kapsamına aktarımı doğrulanmadı
problems.status: unvalidated capability, not a diagnosed solver bug
problems.evidence: Native NK on/off tests already failed their common effect gate. Flow NK source does not establish equivalence to the fully coupled RANS smoothing paper or fully linearized adjoint nested-Krylov systems.
problems.test: Branch only after N01/N02: measured excessive inner work→one forcing-policy prototype; good inner correction but nonlinear model defect→one globalization study; localized obstacle→separately derived residual-smoothing prototype.
acceptance_and_stop: do not claim native NK is EW or Mavriplis smoothing
do not import adjoint-M6 performance to primal SA
preserve benchmark physical conditions and gates
no blind multi-parameter sweep or unbudgeted training
problems.expected_information: A justified next algorithm rather than another unexplained setting change.
problems.lightweight_fit: Deferred until diagnostics; solver source available, but validation and implementation cost exceed passive observation.

core_sources.title: Pinned SU2v8.5.0 source: FGMRES, implicit update and Newton-Krylov
core_sources.reading_depth: Hashed local actually-built source read; pinned contents API separately opened for CSysSolve, CNewtonIntegration and both flow template files.
core_sources.findings_tr: FGMRES çıktısı azaltılmış sistem kestirimi. Standart primal monitoring kapalı; recomputeRes ayrıca varsayılan false. Gerçek uygulama iki geçişli CGS; fonksiyon adı eski. Akış implicit A pseudo-time eki taşır; δ sonradan yerel relaxation ile uygulanır. NK akış üzerinde ayrı tolerans-relaxation çizelgesi içerir.
core_sources.limits: Source semantics establish what must be measured, not a present causal error. Exact norm and update state must be tied to the native call.
core_sources.local_fit: Exact installed/compiled version and native Windows source path. No new package.
core_sources.retrieval_discrepancy: web raw renderer showed1607 lines with older MGS body; connector contents API showed58440 characters/1734 newline parts and CGS2, agreeing semantically with hashed local1733-line source. Use pinned local/API, not cached raw line presentation.

core_sources.title: SU2 Linear Solvers and Preconditioners
core_sources.reading_depth: Full option and setup-advice page opened.
core_sources.findings_tr: CFL, iç tolerans, iterasyon ve preconditioner maliyeti birlikte düşünülür; tek evrensel ayar yok. FGMRES belleği iterasyonla büyür. LINELET duvar-normal çizgilerde tridiagonal, dışarıda Jacobi yaklaşımıdır. Dış residual yakınsamadan gevşek iç tolerans fizik kabulü değildir.
core_sources.limits: Documentation path is v7; each new option must be checked against pinned8.5.0 source/build. PaStiX support is not proof of a working Windows installation.
core_sources.local_fit: Guidance only; existing native options first, no external solver installation recommended.

core_sources.title: SA Expected Results -2D Zero Pressure Gradient Flat Plate
core_sources.kind: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource primary benchmark
core_sources.publication_date: living reference page, no single publication date
core_sources.reading_depth: Full page opened, including numerical formulations, convergence and leading-edge/outflow caveats.
core_sources.findings_tr: CFL3D/FUN3D sonuçları beş ağdaki sayısal referanslardır. Akı/UMUSCL ayrıntıları aynı değildir. Ön kenarda Cf tekilliği ve çıkış köşesi davranışı toplam sürükleme yakınsamasını zorlaştırır. Yazdırılan basamak sayısı elde edilen çözüm toleransı değildir.
core_sources.limits: Not a wind-tunnel measurement and not a universal cross-code residual threshold. Raw CFD references cannot establish physical validation.
core_sources.local_fit: Directly relevant frozen source flat-plate case; preserve actual local source conditions and all point differences.

core_sources.title: Choosing the Forcing Terms in an Inexact Newton Method
core_sources.authors: Stanley C. Eisenstat; Homer F. Walker
core_sources.reading_depth: Publisher abstract opened. Full author PDF open timed out; search extraction provided pages16-17, including forcing inequality and oversolving discussion. Do not claim full theorem/experiment review.
core_sources.findings_tr: İç doğrusal doğruluk dış nonlinear ilerlemeye göre seçilmelidir. Aşırı sıkı iç çözüm, nonlinear modelin güvenilir olmadığı bölgede gereksiz masraf üretebilir. Forcing koşulu gerçek F ve türev modeline bağlıdır.
core_sources.limits: Theorems require their hypotheses. Existing SU2 pseudo-time/approximate-Jacobian, segregated-SA configuration is not automatically the original algorithm.
core_sources.local_fit: Conditional algorithm design after N01; no claim that SU2 already implements EW by naming a tolerance parameter.

core_sources.title: A Residual Smoothing Strategy for Accelerating Newton Method Continuation
core_sources.reading_depth: Full HTML opened; formulation, coupled RANS scope and steady3D example examined.
core_sources.findings_tr: Pseudo-transient Newton sağ tarafına tutarlı smoothing katkısı önerilir; Newton Jacobian'ı değiştirilmez. Küçük ve büyük pseudo-time limitlerinde yöntem davranışı açıklanır. Yerel nonlinear engel tanısı için fikir sağlar.
core_sources.limits: Not equivalent to LINELET linear preconditioning or native NEWTON_KRYLOV toggle. Paper uses its own RANS framework and large3D cases; no local speed or correctness guarantee.
core_sources.local_fit: Requires a separately derived source prototype and root-consistency checks; deferred until N01-N02 evidence.

core_sources.title: Comparative study of inner-outer Krylov solvers for linear systems in structured and high-order unstructured CFD problems
core_sources.authors: Mehdi Jadoui; Christophe Blondeau; Emeric Martin; Florent Renac; François-Xavier Roux
core_sources.kind: original journal paper / arXiv full text
core_sources.reading_depth: Full HTML opened; sections3.1,4.2.1,4.2.2,5 read for true/least-squares residual distinction, M6 and implementation caveats.
core_sources.findings_tr: Gerçek ve least-squares artığı ayrı izlenir. M6 adjoint örneğinde kestirim azalırken gerçek artığın durması ve ortogonalleştirme/preconditioning etkisi gösterilir. Bu, eksik ölçümümüz için güçlü gerekçedir.
core_sources.limits: Fully linearized turbulent adjoint systems in elsA/Aghora differ from local SU2 primal segregated flow/SA. Their nested/deflation speedups and diagnosis do not transfer. Local SU2 already has CGS twice.
core_sources.local_fit: Passive true-residual observation applies immediately in principle; larger algorithm changes are conditional and not installed.

core_sources.title: Reliable and efficient steady CFD from surrogate predictions through Newton-Krylov correction
core_sources.authors: Mingcheng Lei; Weishao Tang; Yufei Zhang; Haixin Chen
core_sources.reading_depth: Abstract page and27-page PDF opened; methodological scope inspected. No independent reproduction or claim that all tables were audited.
core_sources.findings_tr: Surrogate tahmini son kabul yerine başlangıç olarak kullanıp Newton-Krylov ile sayısal düzeltme yapar. Güvenilirlik mimarisi açısından ilgili bir yeni çalışma; terminal solver denetimi hâlâ gerekli.
core_sources.limits: Training/data/model and its solver stack are not present or reproduced locally. Current seed already advanced; new surrogate does not resolve the missing inner-residual measurement.
core_sources.local_fit: Deferred research direction; no training, model download or projected speed guarantee.
